task.title: Extract the pager: three near-identical copies, /my's two carry the P6-133 bugs
task.description:
Found during P6-130-133 (2026-08-12): the pager is not a shared component — three near-identical copies exist: app/src/catalog.rs (fixed by P6-133), app/src/my/all_cards.rs ~:612, and app/src/my/collection.rs ~:2186. Both /my copies still have the two P6-133 bugs: paged derived from the URL (premature '← Back to the start' during an in-flight Next) and an unconditional <nav aria-label=Pagination> that renders as an empty named landmark on single-page results.

The honest fix is extracting ONE pager component (the catalog's post-P6-133 shape: payload-derived paged, pager_is_needed gate, PageLink inertness) and pointing all three sites at it, rather than patching two copies. See specs/app-ui.md 'Catalog paging honesty (2026-08-12)' Findings for the full context.

Evidence added 2026-08-12 (P6-086 scope check): /my's Pager (app/src/my/all_cards.rs ~:611) is also missing the P6-130 displaced_by staleness guard — a mid-debounce Next click there loses the page turn (catalog's PageLink gates this; /my's plain <a> doesn't). Extraction should carry the guard to all three sites.
